Subject: Load-in plan & suggested priority map for Hall B - first draft

Hey Logan / Marissa,

Attached is our first-pass load-in priority map for Hall B (load_in_priority_map_v3.pdf) plus an initial signage manifest (initial_signage_manifest.xlsx). We tried to keep the demo pit toward Gate 4 to minimize aisle congestion during crate roll — see the highlighted red sequence.

High-level asks from our side:
- Can you confirm which signage Redwood will provide vs. ExpoWorks? (we assumed Redwood supplies printed graphics and counters)
- Any crates or demo units that must be staged inside the booth prior to the main installation window?
- Confirm kiosk power point counts for Bay 4 and Bay 7 so we can reserve AV runs.

Timing: we have a 06:00–10:00 load-in window on day 0; our crew can stage signage at 05:30 if someone approves pre-staging.

Attachment stubs: load_in_priority_map_v3.pdf (map), initial_signage_manifest.xlsx (manifest)

Sam — thanks for the quick turnaround. I made inline notes on the map (see load_in_priority_map_v3_annotated.pdf) — major items below: 

- Demo pit: move primary demo crate from Bay 2 -> Bay 4 (closer to power riser).
- Priority sequence: swap sequence 2 & 3 so the printed collateral arrives after the structural backwall is set (avoids footprint overlap).
- Kiosk power: confirm 2x 20A circuits at Bay 4 and 1x 20A at Bay 7. If West Coast AV doesn't have those reserved, we'll need a hard run.

Marissa — can Redwood own printed signage (backwall, counter cards, and 6 wayfinder signs)? If yes, we will send final sizes and the signage_asset_list.xlsx with counts.

Sam — please confirm freight arrival times for crates A/B/C and whether ExpoWorks can stage signage at 05:30 under the earlier crew call. We still need explicit sign-off on any hanging hardware.

Attachment stub: load_in_priority_map_v3_annotated.pdf

- Backwall: 1 (10ft x 8ft)
- Wayfinding double-sided signs: 6
- Counter top graphics: 4
- Handout tray cards / quick sheets: 600

I'll attach the signage_asset_list.xlsx with the dimensions and print specs. Please confirm final sizes by EOD so we can queue the print shop — turnaround is 48 hours once we sign off.

Also, Mateo, can you reach out to West Coast AV ops (ops@wcav.com) and confirm whether they can hang the backwall frame on the trade show rigging or if we need ExpoWorks to provide a freestanding solution? If rigging is allowed we need their hanging ETA and weight limits.
